rules.content:
SELECT
    t.transaction_id,
    t.timestamp,
    t.from_wallet,
    t.to_wallet,
    t.amount_usd,
    t.stablecoin_type,
    s.ofac_designation_date,
    s.entity_name AS sanctioned_entity,
    e.hop_distance,
    e.exposure_score
FROM blockchain_transactions t
JOIN wallet_exposure_analysis e ON t.from_wallet = e.wallet_address OR t.to_wallet = e.wallet_address
JOIN ofac_sdn_wallet_clusters s ON e.sanctioned_cluster_id = s.cluster_id
WHERE t.timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND e.hop_distance <= 3
  AND t.amount_usd >= 10000
ORDER BY e.exposure_score DESC, t.amount_usd DESC;
rules.title: SQL -- OFAC SDN List Cross-Referencing with Blockchain Exposure (Phase 2-4)

rules.content:
index=bgp_routing sourcetype=bgp_updates
| eval event_type = case(
    action="announce", "BGP_ANNOUNCE",
    action="withdraw", "BGP_WITHDRAW"
)
| join type=left asn [
    | inputlookup ofac_sanctioned_asns.csv
    | rename asn AS sanctioned_asn, entity_name AS sanctioned_entity
    | eval asn = sanctioned_asn
]
| stats
    count AS bgp_events,
    dc(prefix) AS unique_prefixes,
    values(sanctioned_entity) AS related_sanctioned_entities,
    earliest(_time) AS first_event,
    latest(_time) AS last_event
    BY asn, peer_asn
| where isnotnull(related_sanctioned_entities)
  OR [
    | inputlookup ofac_sanctioned_asn_peers.csv
    | return 1000 peer_asn
  ]
| eval time_window_hours = round((last_event - first_event) / 3600, 2)
| where bgp_events >= 5 AND time_window_hours <= 72
| table asn, peer_asn, bgp_events, unique_prefixes, related_sanctioned_entities, first_event, last_event, time_window_hours
| sort - bgp_events
rules.title: Splunk -- BPH Rebranding Detection via BGP/ASN Analysis (Phase 3)

rules.content:
title: Infrastructure Migration Correlated with OFAC Sanctions Announcement
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects infrastructure migration patterns (DNS record changes, new domain
  registrations, BGP route announcements) that occur within a 72-hour window
  of OFAC SDN list updates targeting hosting or financial infrastructure
  entities. Sanctioned entities execute pre-planned migration sequences that
  generate observable infrastructure signals correlated with sanctions
  announcement timelines.
logsource:
    product: dns
    service: passive_dns
detection:
    selection_dns_migration:
        event_type: 'dns_record_change'
        record_type:
            - 'A'
            - 'AAAA'
            - 'CNAME'
            - 'NS'
    filter_sanctioned_infrastructure:
        previous_ip|cidr:
            - 'sanctioned_ip_range_1/24'
            - 'sanctioned_ip_range_2/24'
    filter_timing:
        ofac_announcement_delta_hours|lte: 72
    condition: selection_dns_migration and filter_sanctioned_infrastructure and filter_timing
level: critical
tags:
    - cfpf.phase2.initial_access
    - cfpf.phase3.positioning
    - attack.t1583.001
    - attack.t1036
    - flame.sanctions_evasion
    - flame.bph_rebranding
rules.title: Sigma -- Sanctions-Announcement Infrastructure Migration Correlation (Phase 2-3)

rules.content:
title: Stablecoin Smart Contract Deployment Without Freeze Function
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects new stablecoin smart contract deployments that lack administrative
  freeze or blacklist functions. Legitimate regulated stablecoins (USDT, USDC)
  include these functions for law enforcement compliance. The deliberate
  absence of freeze capability — as seen in Huione's USDH — indicates a
  stablecoin designed specifically for sanctions evasion and law enforcement
  resistance.
logsource:
    product: blockchain
    service: smart_contract_deployment
detection:
    selection:
        contract_type: 'ERC20_stablecoin'
        has_freeze_function: false
        has_blacklist_function: false
        initial_supply_usd|gte: 1000000
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - cfpf.phase2.initial_access
    - flame.sanctions_evasion
    - flame.stablecoin
    - flame.usdh
rules.title: Sigma -- Unfreezable Stablecoin Contract Detection (Phase 2)
